title: Universal Validity of Non-Partition Resampling Laws for Conditional Randomization Tests
banked_reason: D0.5 math referee passed with verified citations and both mandated repairs, but the contribution panel assessed paper_score_ceiling 6.6 below the field threshold 7.4.
gap_reasons: The “power-optimal” theorem proves optimality only for a prespecified finite score catalogue and level, not for effect-quantile inference generally or for an actual Cai–Owusu exposure fiber.

Strict power improvement is demonstrated only by constructed supports—most notably the three-cycle at level 2/3 and the asymmetric-isolate construction at alpha equal to one state’s mass—so the note supplies no evidence of useful gains at conventional levels.

The network result delivers an exact but exponentially large weak-order enumeration and algebraic inversion, without the promised empirical fiber computation needed to establish practical relevance or reproducibility.

DELETE this unconsumed wrapper theorem: it merely restates thm:exact-network-schedule-reduction and prop:no-interference-reduction, so the headline can be carried by those substantive nodes (and prose) without a second numbered claim.
proof_attempt_summary: Discovery proved the finite universal-validity characterization, its subset recursion and certificates, catalogue-level power optimization, and an exact finite network schedule reduction; the D0.5 math referee passed after both citation leaves were verified and the requested evaluation-map and related-work repairs landed. The field-tier promise collapsed because power improvement was shown only on constructed supports and no conventional-level Cai–Owusu exposure-fiber computation established practical gain; the contribution panel therefore capped the paper at subfield (6.6 versus the 7.4 field threshold). A future re-raise should reuse the listed theorem graph and solver artifacts, delete the redundant wrapper theorem, and supply the prespecified real-fiber computation with reproducible strict partition-kernel power-gap certificates.
tldr: A finite conditional randomization law need not resample from a partition cell. Universal validity of an arbitrary legal row kernel is characterized exactly by the inequalities \(d_K(A)\geq\pi(A)\), with an equivalent peeling core, an \(O(m2^m)\) separator, and a finite union-of-polyhedra design region. A generic asymmetric-isolate support criterion constructs a valid nonpartition kernel with power \(\pi(x)=\alpha\) against zero for every legal partition kernel; every one-way three-cycle support is a corollary, and the original cyclic matrix remains an exact \(2/3\)-power stress test. On a predeclared network-exposure fiber, finite weak-order enumeration and positive-slack linear feasibility compute each worst-case bounded-null value. Projecting the finitely many cells onto the threshold line evaluates \(b_k(x_0;\alpha)\) from interval endpoints and gives \(\ell_k(e;\alpha)=b_k(X;\alpha)\) simultaneously for all effect quantiles. This exact network reduction does not reproduce the adjusted-outcome computations of Caughey--Dafoe--Li--Miratrix or Su--Li; a two-unit example gives frozen and comparator values \(1\) and \(1/2\), respectively.
gap: Conditional randomization under interference is operationally partition-based, while arbitrary-permutation validity relies on auxiliary symmetrization; even the finite-sample distribution and quantile improvements of Chen and Li (2026) remain in complete, stratified, sampling-based, or matched no-interference designs and do not resolve assignment-coupled network schedules.
fill: The project gives the exact row-kernel validity geometry, a worked directed-cycle certificate with a strict partition power gap, and certified power design, then develops exact bounded-null schedule optimization and simultaneous quantile projection on imputable network fibers under the explicit universal-validity inequalities.
